name: ai-creator-marketplace
description: CRE8R - AI creator marketplace (Next.js frontend + NestJS backend)

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npx --prefix backend tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
